confidence: Med — Вы, предзаказ (Wolt KZ), самовывоз (Yandex Eda KZ), Kaspi QR/Halyk payments are confirmed on Kazakhstan pages; фудтрак, кухонный экран, ККМ, plan names and the Pay at Hatch wording rest on general Russian usage. csvRows come from the US-indexed research tool for the exact primary keyword and are dominated by Russian-Federation sites — not Kazakhstan Google ranks.
decisions: Order button: Kazakhstan’s Law “О защите прав потребителей” (2010) has no statutory button wording (no EU-style rule found); use the market norm “Оформить заказ”, card variant “Оплатить {amount}”.

Pay at Hatch: recommend “Оплата в фудтраке” (feature) / “Оплата на месте” (button). Avoid “оплата при получении”, “оплата курьеру”, “наложенный платёж” (standard cash-on-delivery wording in Russian-language e-commerce).
Capital “Вы/Ваш” (Kaspi style) vs lower-case “вы” (most app UIs): recommend capital Вы to match Kaspi, the KZ benchmark; Dominic may prefer lower-case for a lighter tone — pick one for all parts.
ru-KZ also serves Kyrgyzstan: keep copy country-neutral (no “тенге” in text — let the app format currency; KG uses сом, +996, .kg).
WhatsApp is widely reported as Kazakhstan’s most-used messenger (general knowledge, not re-checked in this research), so WhatsApp auto-replies can be a headline feature for KZ.
